race.description: Cheering For The Tigers Super Mdn Plate
race.comment: EL COOL GEE (11) fourth up today and ticks plenty of boxes from the draw. Gripped on late in the heavy going to run third over 1400m at Wagga. Steps up a level and maps to get every chance with the claim. FROSTED AMBER (6) has failed to fill a placing at her last few runs, the latest a fourth over 1170m at Wangaratta, beaten 4.5 lengths. Well drawn and gets chance. PASSING THROUGH (7) last appeared 11 weeks ago when she finished ninth over 1425m at Moruya. Finds a suitable race and can feature. EIGHT HIGH (2) making debut. Will need to show more than latest trial when seventh at Bendigo over 1300m. Watch the betting.
